c74object.name: evi_ringmod_enhanced
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_ringmod_enhanced.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_ringmod_enhanced.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_ringmod_enhanced.genexpr file also requires:
evi_ssb.genexpr
evi_butterworth.genexpr
About this File:
